source.scope: 13 retained SavedVariables captures plus XmlFrameLevelProbe documented behavior without retained raw capture
source.normalization: Probe subfindings use changed direction and valid dot-path symbols rooted in the probe addon.

documented_states.note: Statuses are preserved here and in the human inventory only; the machine manifest remains neutral until item-specific evidence is attached.

occurrences.detail: Frame, AnimationGroup, and all nine Animation subtypes match the documented matrix: unsupported HasScript calls succeed and return false, while SetScript rejects those handlers.
Repeated scalar SetAttribute dispatches OnAttributeChanged; explicit false is preserved and delivered as false.
Repeated ShowUIPanel pulse followed by CloseAllWindows preserves the expected panel-stack behavior.
Normal addon frames remain un-forbidden; SetForbidden does not create forbidden state.
CreateForbiddenFrame is nil on retail, so the probe does not enter its creation or EnumerateFrames branch.
Valid RegisterUnitEvent registration works; invalid unit filters are dropped while the event remains registered.
Wildcard GetAttribute preserves explicit stored false.
Wildcard true/string values and one-, two-, and three-argument lookup behavior are preserved.
Raise/Lower affect same-level ties but cannot overtake a higher frame level.
GetMouseFoci/GetMouseFocus shape and hit ordering after Raise/Lower.
tinsert(frame, foo), frame slot contents, and DevTools_Dump output metadata.
Frame slot [0] contains the identity userdata token.
Replacing [0] redirects protection and method dispatch; [1] alone does not.
Duplicate named frames receive fresh Lua objects, identity tokens, and custom-field state.
The normal binding slot succeeds and chains; explicit slots 0 and 2 return false and GetScript reports nil for those slots.
Legacy Protect and SetProtected methods are absent and calls fail.
Secure-template buttons report protected state while ordinary frames do not.
Child, grandchild, and protected-anchor return values are captured.
Direct unanchored frame-layer FontStrings receive the observed default anchors and justification.
Implicit ButtonText FontString behavior matches the probe matrix.
No-size, width-only, height-only, and width+height variants are captured.
TOP/BOTTOM/LEFT/RIGHT/TOPLEFT controls distinguish missing from partial anchoring.
EditBox FontStrings, including sized and inset variants, are captured.
MessageFrame and ScrollingMessageFrame owner/region behavior and TextInsets effects.
Plain frame protection/forbidden state and legacy setter behavior.
XML protected=true frame state and setters.
Secure-template child state and Blizzard Store frame observations.
DISPLAY_SIZE_CHANGED, UI_SCALE_CHANGED, and relevant CVAR_UPDATE ordering.
Same-size maximize/restore duplicate display/scale event pair.
nil, no-argument, boolean, numeric, empty, and unknown atlas inputs.
UI-Panel-Button-Up path assignment and retained FDID 130828.
SetTexture(nil) and no-argument clearing behavior.
Bare frameLevel versus fixedFrameLevel=true semantics.
Parent-level changes, unfixed-child propagation, and Lua SetFrameLevel reparenting.
HasFixedFrameLevel and IsUsingParentLevel observations.
Raw SavedVariables capture was not retained; only documented behavior remains.
Real and synthetic Store dropdown population plus button count/state.
Store frame/descendant forbidden/protected scan via /sfp.
